System & DAE

Core system construction, DAE structures, and data management.

System Builder

System-level structures and per-unit conversion from the system/ directory.

Powerful.Foundation.SystemModel — Type
SystemModel(case::PowerFlowData.Network, model_types=nothing;
            auto_setup=true, convert_to_pu=true, system_base=100.0,
            addressing=NaturalAddressing())

Convenience constructor to create a SystemModel from a PowerFlowData case.

Arguments

  • case: PowerFlowData Network object (from PowerFlowData.parse_network)
  • model_types: Optional tuple/vector of model types. If nothing (default), uses all_models()
  • auto_setup::Bool=true: Automatically call setup!() to assign addresses
  • convert_to_pu::Bool=true: Convert models to per-unit (recommended)
  • system_base::Float64=100.0: System base power in MVA (used if convert_to_pu=true)
  • addressing::AddressingStrategy=NaturalAddressing(): Address reordering strategy
    • NaturalAddressing(): Default sequential ordering
    • AMDAddressing(): Automatic AMD reordering for sparse factorization
    • CustomPermutation(perm): User-provided permutation vector

Workflows

Modern Workflow (Recommended - with per-unit conversion)

using PowerFlowData
using Powerful

case = PowerFlowData.parse_network("cases/ieee14.raw")
sys = SystemModel(case)  # Auto-converts to per-unit on 100 MVA base

# Access original data (preserved automatically)
sys.parsed_data.models.PQ.pl[1]  # → 21.7 MW (original)
sys.models.PQ.pl[1]              # → 0.217 pu (computational)

# Use different system base
sys = SystemModel(case; system_base=500.0)  # 500 MVA base

# Use AMD addressing for better sparse factorization
sys = SystemModel(case; addressing=AMDAddressing())

Explicit Workflow (Maximum Control)

# For advanced users who need full control over each step
case = PowerFlowData.parse_network("cases/ieee14.raw")
models = load_models(case, all_models())
parsed = ParsedSystemData(models, 100.0)
result = convert_system_to_per_unit(parsed.models, parsed.system_base, external)
am = AddressManager()
sys = SystemModel(am, result.models; parsed_data=parsed, pu_coeffs=result.coeffs)

See Also

  • ParsedSystemData: Container for original data
  • convert_system_to_per_unit: Per-unit conversion
  • load_models: Parse models from case

Powerful.Foundation.SystemModel — Method
SystemModel(components::NamedTuple)

Convenience constructor for creating a SystemModel from pre-parsed model components.

This constructor automatically:

  1. Applies external-to-internal index mapping (ext2int)
  2. Retrieves external parameters from model metadata
  3. Creates the SystemModel with proper index ordering

Arguments

  • components: NamedTuple of model arrays (e.g., from load_models)

Example

models = load_models(case, all_models())
sys = SystemModel(models)  # Auto-populates external and order

Note

For full control over per-unit conversion and data preservation, use SystemModel(case::PowerFlowData.Network) instead.
